final: WITH per_type AS (SELECT COALESCE(tr.tradekind, '(no type)') AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT tx.trdref) AS trader_count FROM transactionrecord tx JOIN trader tr ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY COALESCE(tr.tradekind, '(no type)')), stats AS (SELECT trader_type, trader_count, SUM(trader_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(trader_count) OVER () AS avg_count FROM per_type) SELECT trader_type, trader_count, 1.0 * trader_count / total_count AS share_of_total, trader_count - avg_count AS above_average_by FROM stats WHERE trader_count > avg_count
